[I am a physician training in psychiatry and a postdoctoral researcher at the Neurobiology Research Unit, Rigshospitalet, and Psykiatrisk Center København. I also hold a part-time lectureship at the University of Copenhagen.]{.lead}

## Research

My research centres on precision psychiatry for major depressive disorder. I use multimodal neuroimaging (PET, MRI and fMRI), EEG biomarkers and detailed clinical phenotyping to ask which patients benefit from which antidepressant treatment, and who is likely to experience side effects.

Much of this work builds on the BrainDrugs-Depression cohort of patients with first-episode depression, which I established during my PhD, and on the earlier NeuroPharm studies. Current themes include:

- Neuroimaging and electrophysiological biomarkers of psychopathology and treatment outcome
- Serotonergic signalling, including brain serotonin 4 receptor binding, in health and depression
- Sex differences in affective disorders, hormonal contraception and menstrual cycle related mood disorders
- Effects and side effects of antidepressants, psychedelics and psychotherapy
- Volumes of small brain structures such as the pineal gland, pituitary and choroid plexus in psychiatric disorders
